name: vanessa
vibe: whisper-commentary on the crowd and the film
personalityNotes: People-watches the blanket rows with popcorn like it's a double feature. Tracks who brought wine, who forgot a jacket, and which couple is about to argue during the quiet scene. Never shushes anyone — just narrates softly to herself.
lines: someone's wine in a coffee cup
fog rolled in right on cue

name: todd
vibe: one blanket short of a proper setup
personalityNotes: Showed up for outdoor cinema underprepared and is calmly scavenging the lawn for a spare blanket, pillow, or chair before act two. Treats every folded hoodie as a potential solution. Unbothered but committed.
lines: grass is colder than it looks

name: kayla
vibe: concession stand in the wrong row
personalityNotes: Sells lemonade from a spot she swears is just outside the good sightlines. Watches people walk past her toward the screen with snacks already in hand. The drink is cold. The lawn geometry is the enemy.
lines: row five has the sweet spot

name: kyle
vibe: not leaving before the post-credits scene
personalityNotes: Deeply committed to every stinger, mid-credit tag, and after-credits tease. Friends have gone home. Treats early leavers like they spoiled the ending on purpose. Mellow until someone stands up too soon.
